intent.en: Rewrite the attempt4 window material under signed criterion v2.1: three-question header; unchanged bitwise SDF entity + scene-a exact-difference lists (recipe 183/73, aa2 172/91; outside-list bitwise, inside <=128, list sha in guards and immutable); 9 entities; 94-entry freeze (9 exes + 83 inputs + 2 lists via the authoring tool + freeze script + GuardsOnly); conditional monitor; preparation checklist; baseline rule (measured next slice); authoring-tool declaration and env-gated body consumption; boundaries. Material only, zero GPU, no freeze.

零 GPU、零冻结、零窗口；未改判据数值/参考/fixtures/内核/历史证据；四门禁 + --no-run 通过。
